name: Attic bedroom
desc: Childhood, hiding, or exile upstairs: a small life lived under someone else's roof.
tags: attic bedroom, sloped ceiling, exposed roof beams, dormer window, narrow bed under the eaves, patchwork quilt, bedside lamp, bare floorboards, cardboard boxes stacked where the roof meets the floor, string of fairy lights, low door, rag rug
prose: an attic bedroom under a sloping beamed ceiling, a narrow bed pushed beneath the eaves, a dormer window at the gable end and cardboard boxes stacked where the roof comes down to meet the floor
note: The slope IS the place - keep sloped ceiling and exposed beams early in the tag string, because when they fall out you are left with an ordinary bedroom and nothing else in the list rescues it. The dormer is the only daylight source; without it the model lights the room from an impossible direction. Cosy cannot be rendered - that is the quilt, the lamp and the rug.
